acrnet_feature_note: Uses acrnet_pctile (percentile within its PSSM regime), NOT the raw probability. Raw acrnet_score is inflated toward 1.0 whenever PSI-BLAST builds no PSSM, which in this set is 67% of negatives but only 2% of positives -- a has_pssm flag alone scores AUROC 0.825, so the raw feature was partly reading profilability, not Acr-likeness.
